title: Script backtraces are subject to the Static Initialization Order Fiasco
body:
### Tested versions

N/A

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

A recent crash backtrace was shared [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/97210#pullrequestreview-2856326593) that looks like this:

```
Thread 0 Crashed::  Dispatch queue: com.apple.main-thread
0   libsystem_kernel.dylib        	       0x19d06d388 __pthread_kill + 8
1   libsystem_pthread.dylib       	       0x19d0a688c pthread_kill + 296
2   libsystem_c.dylib             	       0x19cfafc60 abort + 124
3   libc++abi.dylib               	       0x19d05c39c abort_message + 132
4   libc++abi.dylib               	       0x19d04acf0 demangling_terminate_handler() + 316
5   libobjc.A.dylib               	       0x19ccd0de4 _objc_terminate() + 172
6   libc++abi.dylib               	       0x19d05b6b0 std::__terminate(void (*)()) + 16
7   libc++abi.dylib               	       0x19d05ec48 __cxxabiv1::failed_throw(__cxxabiv1::__cxa_exception*) + 88
8   libc++abi.dylib               	       0x19d05ebf0 __cxa_throw + 92
9   libc++.1.dylib                	       0x19cfd66a4 std::__1::__throw_system_error[abi:ne190102](std::__1::error_code, char const*) + 92
10  libc++.1.dylib                	       0x19cfd6648 std::__1::__throw_system_error(int, char const*) + 32
11  libc++.1.dylib                	       0x19cfd85b8 std::__1::recursive_mutex::lock() + 40
12  Godot                         	       0x10b2375b0 std::__1::unique_lock<std::__1::recursive_mutex>::unique_lock[abi:nn190102](std::__1::recursive_mutex&) + 52
13  Godot                         	       0x10b237374 std::__1::unique_lock<std::__1::recursive_mutex>::unique_lock[abi:nn190102](std::__1::recursive_mutex&) + 36
14  Godot                         	       0x10b237340 MutexLock<MutexImpl<std::__1::recursive_mutex>>::MutexLock(MutexImpl<std::__1::recursive_mutex> const&) + 36
15  Godot                         	       0x10b2373a8 MutexLock<MutexImpl<std::__1::recursive_mutex>>::MutexLock(MutexImpl<std::__1::recursive_mutex> const&) + 36
16  Godot                         	       0x10b9021fc ScriptServer::are_languages_initialized() + 32
17  Godot                         	       0x10b9a5790 _err_print_error(char const*, char const*, int, char const*, char const*, bool, ErrorHandlerType) + 80
18  Godot                         	       0x10b9a5998 _err_print_error(char const*, char const*, int, String const&, bool, ErrorHandlerType) + 128
19  Godot                         	       0x10b51cd8c PagedAllocator<Variant::Pools::BucketMedium, true, 4096u>::~PagedAllocator() + 216
20  Godot                         	       0x10b50b5d0 PagedAllocator<Variant::Pools::BucketMedium, true, 4096u>::~PagedAllocator() + 28
21  libsystem_c.dylib             	       0x19cf5e944 __cxa_finalize_ranges + 480
22  libsystem_c.dylib             	       0x19cf5e704 exit + 44
```

... which points to this code likely being the culprit:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/64b09905c7b2877f8aef99d8b63e73e5d31acfb9/core/error/error_macros.cpp#L99-L101

... which is likely being called as part of this `ERR_PRINT`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/64b09905c7b2877f8aef99d8b63e73e5d31acfb9/core/templates/paged_allocator.h#L168-L170

I haven't reproduced this crash myself, but this all points to a pretty serious flaw in how we ended up using `ScriptServer` as part of #91006.

More specifically, this crash is almost certainly caused by the [Static Initialization Order Fiasco](https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/siof.html), as by the time this `PagedAllocator` (probably one of the ones in `Variant::Pool`) is destroyed, the `static Mutex languages_mutex` in `ScriptServer` can potentially have undergone its destruction already, leaving it in some kind of undefined crash-prone state.

(The "fiasco" part of this problem is, as mentioned in the link, the fact that the initialization order of static variables across different translation units is undefined, and since they will be destroyed in reverse order, so is the order of their destruction.)
